text.p: Latvian bank Rietumu Bank said on Thursday that it was to reorganise its share capital and would launch its shares on the stock exchange at the end of this year or the start of next year.
The bank earlier reported that its 1996 profit rose to 4.93 million lats from 2.10 million lats the previous year.
"At the start of March 1997 the Bank of Latvia allowed Rietumu Bank to carry out a shareholder restructuring," the bank said in a statement, adding that several shareholders became one legal entity.
"The bank's shareholders plan at the end of 1997, start of 1998 plan to offer a part of the share's of Rietumu Bank for trade on the Riga bourse," the bank added.
Unibanka is currently the only quoted bank while Rigas kommercbanka has said it wants to be listed on the market but has not given a firm date.
